mechanic: Static two-column hero (max-w-1440 1.2fr/0.8fr grid): a left value-prop column (green pulsing 'BOOKING FOR SUMMER' pill, SK-Reykjavik headline with an inline orange DeepShadowIcon TrendingUp plaque, soft-shadow CTA pair, and a verified-clients + 5-star social-proof strip) beside a right column of dual framer-motion vertical tracks endlessly translating Y (tripled ClientCard list, y:[0,-1200] over 40s linear) under top/bottom #F7F7F7 fade masks, with each card fade-scaling in on load and alternately rotated +/-3deg.
techDelivery: React (TypeScript) + Tailwind CSS v4 (@theme + @layer base in index.css, arbitrary-value utilities) + motion/react for the infinite marquee + load animations + lucide-react icons; two web fonts (Inter via Google Fonts, SK Reykjavik Rounded via onlinewebfonts CDN). Authored as index.css + App.tsx with inline mock data.
reskinNotes: Brand identity is almost entirely in inline Tailwind arbitrary-value hexes rather than CSS variables, so reskinning means rewriting class strings: the orange #F25C40 is baked into DeepShadowIcon (box + blur glow), DeepShadowAvatar's hasGlow, and the headline plaque; the soft-3D 'deep shadow' look depends on hand-tuned multi-layer box-shadows (e.g. shadow-[0px_0px_5px_rgba(255,255,255,0.5)_inset,0px_8px_20px_rgba(242,92,64,0.35)] on the icon, the #212121/#202020 button glow+inset stack, black blur backdrops on avatars) whose rgba values must be recolored by hand per brand. Several non-role hexes live only in markup: pulse dot bg #52D352 + its 0.6-alpha green glow and the #D1F2D1 pill border (green 'summer' accent, distinct from the orange/gold brand accents), star color #FFB648, and DeepShadowButton bg #202020. The page has no real background image; bg is the flat #F7F7F7 that also drives the marquee fade-mask gradients. The marquee motion is hardcoded in pixel space (y:[0,-1200] and the tablet track's y:[-600,-1800]) and assumes a specific ClientCard height x tripled-list length, so changing card count/size requires retuning those keyframes. All copy (the 'BOOKING FOR SUMMER' badge, the 'Expanding ... reach with every lead' headline with its inline icon split, the subheadline, both CTA labels, the VERIFIED CLIENTS / TOP TIER QUALITY 5/5 labels, and every CLIENT_CALLS day/date/name/time/duration) is hardcoded in App.tsx and must be edited in code. SK Reykjavik Rounded is loaded from a third-party onlinewebfonts CDN (licensing/availability caveat) and the negative-tracking headline is metric-dependent on it.
